application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
T1. Japanese Maple	

Front Garden:

To achieve your pruning plan and match the height of the top window seal, we will need to adopt the following methods.

Drop Crutching Technique:

Removing upright leaders and redirecting growth to lower lateral branches.
Making cuts just above a side branch that is at least ? the diameter of the branch being removed.
Ensuring the side branch is pointing outward or downward to maintain the layered look.

Specification:

Reduce height to match the level of the 1st floor seal, using the above technique.
Reduce the south section of the crown by 2m, blending with the remainder of the crown, leaving a layered and natural appearance.

Retain the north/lowest lateral spreading branches for screening.

The tree's current height is 4.5m, and its crown spread is 7m
After the proposed works, the tree's height is 3m and the crown spread is 5m.
